item.description:
NeoMount 1.10.3

  • 修复偏好设置、连接表单等区域滚动条后的白色底条。
  • 重启时恢复普通窗口大小，避免记住放大动画中的尺寸。
  • 应用标识统一为 cn.neohub.neomount，保留已有连接、密码和常用偏好。

从 1.10.2 或更早版本升级，请先关闭旧版登录启动并退出，再通过 DMG 替换应用一次。新版本可继续使用内置更新，需要时请重新开启登录启动。

English

  • Removed opaque scrollbar gutters from Preferences, connection forms and other scrolling areas.
  • Restore normal window geometry after restarting instead of intermediate zoom sizes.
  • Unified app identifier: cn.neohub.neomount. Existing connections, saved passwords and common preferences are retained.

Version 1.10.2 and earlier require a one-time DMG installation. Disable launch at login in the old version and quit it before replacing the app. Re-enable launch at login in the new version if needed. Future versions support in-app updates.
